title: Cyan opening: public-geometry diagnosis and actual V13 outcome
problem: V10 released Cyan, but a 55 mm opening left the middle bead occluded and unaccepted by the next RGB observation.
selection: Public robot mesh ray prediction found 65 mm cleared 11/13 sampled middle-bead rays, while 75/80/90 mm cleared 13/13. The original six collision groups, board uncertainty and joint limits passed for all tested widths. 75 mm was the smallest fully clear tested option.

image.comparison: Two actual runs, not identical-state A/B trials.

scope: Historical V10/V13 development comparison: a wider opening repaired Cyan visibility, followed by successful release and next-piece handoff in V13. V13 ended at 82/84 checkpoints; the separate current V6 execution is accepted at 84/84 with terminal RGB confirmation. The pictured V13 measurements are not relabeled as V6.

rounds.label: Release
rounds.attempt: The original opening left the next RGB check unaccepted.
rounds.diagnosis: The moving finger still crossed the middle bead in the top image.
rounds.change: Use the recorded joint state and public finger mesh to locate the occlusion.
rounds.outcome: The geometry identified the finger responsible.

rounds.label: Calculate
rounds.diagnosis: A small increase still left some bead rays blocked.
rounds.change: Select the smallest tested opening that cleared every sampled ray and passed the existing guards.
rounds.outcome: The calculation selected a 75 mm opening.

rounds.label: Replay
rounds.attempt: Execute the revised opening and look again.
rounds.outcome: Cyan passed release and next-piece handoff checks; independent audit confirmed all twelve physical placements at the end of the run.

current_continuous_execution.terminal_explanation: All 84 original checkpoints passed, including Red final handoff and finish. Two actual terminal RGB observations at 704.36 and 705.38 s independently support the same complete rigid-CAD packing.
current_continuous_execution.terminal_RGB_scope: 41 currently labeled material sites constrain a unique complete 55-site packing; 14 occluded sites are inferred using known rigid geometry, not individually measured.
current_continuous_execution.evaluation_basis: Independent audit of saved native states and original checkpoint contracts, plus independently recomputed actual terminal RGB witnesses. Simulator diagnostics are not policy inputs.
current_continuous_execution.camera_scope: four custom fixed virtual RGB cameras; no wrist or official three-camera qualification
current_continuous_execution.display_camera_scope: Separate posthoc presentation observer; never a policy sensor.
current_continuous_execution.scope: One fresh full-twelve simulation, seed 0, layout C, four custom fixed RGB cameras. Earlier V13 images and repair clips remain historical development evidence.

narrative.title: Cyan: make the release visible.
narrative.problem: The piece was released, but a finger still covered the bead needed by the next visual check.
narrative.result: The V13 development run earned two accepted Cyan observations after opening wider. The separate current V6 run completes all twelve pieces and all 84 checkpoints.
narrative.scope: Historical V13 physical assembly; current V6 acceptance is documented separately.
